activities.name: Cappadocia balloon flights
activities.note: flights are scheduled every month of the year — the question is whether yours gets off the ground. Book your first morning, so a cancellation still leaves you another try

windows.reason: spring and autumn give the highest chance of flying and the best conditions
statistically the most reliable month of all, with a cancellation rate around 7%
fog, snow and sustained wind cancel more than half of scheduled flights — though January and February are the months to fly if you want the valleys under snow
